about_the_game:
SQUADX proudly presents MUAY THAI XTREME, the world’s first multiplayer fighting game fully dedicated to the art of Muay Thai. Designed with authenticity, tactical depth, and competitive intensity, it’s more than a fighting game—it’s the ultimate Muay Thai experience.

What You’ll Get

When you purchase MUAY THAI XTREME, you gain access to:

  • Multiplayer Modes

    • Ranked online battles: Prove your skill against fighters worldwide.

    • Casual matches: Train or spar with friends without pressure.

    • Private lobbies: Create custom matches for your community.

  • Authentic Fighting Styles
    Choose from multiple Tactical Styles, each inspired by real Muay Thai techniques, offering unique strengths, combos, and strategies.

  • Signature Mechanics

    • Decisive Move: Turn the tide with game-changing finishing techniques.

    • Weak Posture: Exploit openings with perfectly timed attacks.

    • Corner Pressure: Dominate opponents with authentic Muay Thai clinch and ring control.

  • Fighter Customization
    Build your own warrior—personalize appearance, gear, stance, and even entrance flair.

  • Arenas
    Fight across multiple stadiums inspired by legendary Muay Thai venues, from underground gyms to grand arenas.

Pre-Season: No Surrender

By joining early, you’ll be part of the exclusive Pre-Season event, which includes:

  • Seasonal challenges and exclusive rewards.

  • Unique Pre-Season cosmetics that won’t return after launch.

This Pre-Season marks the beginning of our journey. As we move toward full launch, expect:

  • New Tactical Styles.

  • Additional arenas and events.

  • Enhanced progression systems and career features.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, Windows 8.1, Windows 10 (64-bit versions only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better / AMD Phenom II X3 or better
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or better / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound Compatible

short_description: Step into the ring with MUAY THAI XTREME, the world’s first dedicated Muay Thai fighting game. Master authentic techniques, customize your fighter, and compete in explosive multiplayer battles. Join the Pre-Season: No Surrender and claim exclusive rewards before the full launch.
